parole.testo: From Swedish Dynamit (brand name) (“dynamite”). Coined by the inventor Nobel. Ultimately from Ancient Greek δύναμις (dúnamis, “power”). With -it ending, a suffix indicating a chemical product.

parole.significato: open-air museum (a museum where the exhibitions are located outdoors)
parole.testo: From Swedish Skansen, the first open-air museum located on the island of Djurgården in Stockholm, Sweden. Ultimately from Swedish skans (“sconce”).
